title: China’s Beauty Market Tilts Toward Dermocosmetics as Local Brands Tighten Their Grip on Tmall
summary: China’s beauty market on Tmall is increasingly being shaped by domestic brands and science-driven skincare, with products focused on skin-barrier repair, sensitive-skin care, and targeted efficacy emerging as the strongest growth drivers across major categories.An analysis by Beauty Economy of Tmall

extraction.key_fact: 티몰에서 중국 로컬 브랜드가 주요 카테고리 상위권을 차지하고 피부 장벽·효능 중심 스킨케어가 성장을 이끌고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Chinese brands maintained overwhelming market leadership across several major categories.
